description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walpitamulla, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510407
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including specific determinations of land ownership, parcel details, and property rights. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
